stemMarkdown: Which investment grew more in percentage terms over its own holding period?

options.markdown: Both grew by the same percentage
Cannot be determined from the data given

solutionMarkdown:
Total growth over the whole holding period:

- A: $\dfrac{27000 - 8000}{8000} \times 100 = 237.5\%$
- B: $\dfrac{16000 - 6250}{6250} \times 100 = 156\%$

**Investment A**, and this is the point of the set: B has the higher annual rate (60% against 50%) and still grew less overall, because it compounded for two years instead of three. A CAGR is only comparable across investments held for the **same** length of time.
